questions.question: Which law describes the behavior of ideal solutions in vapor-liquid equilibrium?
In the VLE process, what occurs at the equilibrium condition?

answers.a: The rate of evaporation is greater than the rate of condensation
answers.b: The chemical potential of the liquid is less than that of the vapor
answers.c: The rates of evaporation and condensation are equal
answers.d: The amount of vapor is negligible compared to the liquid

questions.question: What effect does increasing temperature typically have on vapor-liquid equilibrium?

answers.c: Has no effect on vapor pressure

questions.question: Why is vapor-liquid equilibrium data important in industrial processes?

answers.a: It complicates the design of chemical reactions
answers.b: It plays no significant role in safety
answers.c: It helps design efficient separation processes like distillation
answers.d: It is mostly theoretical and rarely used in practice
